role:</strong></p> <p>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.</p> <p>We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.</p> <p>We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.</p> <p><strong>This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world.</strong>&nbsp;The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.</li> <li><strong>You want to build, not maintain.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.</li> <li><strong>You want to work where AI meets the physical world.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.</li> <li><strong>You believe customers are more than a number.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. It's ambition.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them.
